notes: Modified cash basis school district; all funds (including School Nutrition) are governmental funds, so business_type is null. Basic statements: Exhibit A (p1 net position, used for balance_sheet), Exhibit B (p2 activities), p3 balance sheet, p4 fund statement by fund, p5 Exhibit D total governmental funds column (used for receipts/disbursements). Beginning cash is the printed total beginning fund balance 6,427,252.57 (p5). Receipts exclude 20,000,000 bond proceeds (debt_proceeds); printed total receipts 33,076,959.20 includes it. Identity: 6,427,252.57 + 13,076,959.20 - 12,832,455.77 + 20,000,000 = 26,671,756.00. Total column nets inter-fund transfers (249,000) to zero via the Reclassifications column, so top-level transfers are null. Combined 'Other' taxes (2,981,755.85) split using General Fund budget schedule (p8) and Special Building schedule (p16); sums to the printed line. 'Miscellaneous local receipts' 669,884.34 split into General Fund other local receipts, Special Building misc, nutrition sales, nutrition misc, and activities/student fee receipts (activities less an inferred 9,000 transfer). 'Other student support' 865,068.08 split into School Nutrition (482,624.70) and Activities (382,443.38) disbursements. Transfer cross-check: Depreciation Fund 'Transfer from general fund' 50,000 (p12) is hidden inside General Fund 2710 Vehicle operation/Student transportation - regular (Exhibit F reclassification p7); Exhibit N Vehicle Operation (p23, 441,199.64) does not show which object holds it, so its object lines stay as printed and detail has a -50,000 contra expenditure line plus -50,000 other financing. School Nutrition 'Allocation from general fund' 240,000 (p15) and 9,000 inside Activities receipts together equal the General Fund 8000 Transfers 249,000 (p11); Exhibit N (p24) confirms the split (School Nutrition Fund 240,000.00, Activity Fund 9,000.00); both recorded as other financing. Detail double counting avoided: General Fund disbursements use the object-level Exhibit N (pp18-24; the v7 re-trim added report pp39-43, so it is now complete through its Transfers section and Total Cash Disbursements 11,319,660.17 on p24) for every program; the budget schedule's program lines (pp10-11) are not recorded (their budget_final figures are only on that schedule). Exhibit N ESSER III (p24) prints object lines summing to 23,925.84 under a subtotal of 33,255.92 (the figure in the budget schedule and the printed total); lines kept as printed and the 9,330.08 gap recorded in report_discrepancies. Exhibit N department names follow the budget schedule codes (e.g. 2650 'Vehicle Purchasing' on Exhibit N = budget 2650 Vehicle operation and maintenance; 6408 = IDEA Part B Birth-21). Only the budget schedule's 8000 Transfers line and the Depreciation transfer contra/other-financing pair stay under the budget schedule, whose expenditure total (p11) counts the Exhibit N lines via includes_schedules. Exhibit E (pp6-7, General Fund components) not recorded in detail; it is covered by Exhibit G (General Fund column), H (Depreciation) and I (Employee Benefit). Student Fee Fund and Depreciation Fund have no disbursements. Zero-actual budget-only lines (2143, 2214, 6412, 6996) omitted. Exhibit N 'Other Purchased Services' mapped to professional/contract services, 'Purchased Property Services' to repairs and maintenance, 'Other Expenses' to miscellaneous expenditure (review). Read pages 1-24 of 24. 'Capital projects' 907,067.62 (p5) split using the Special Building Fund schedule (p16): building project costs 543,950.92 (capital outlay) and bond issuance costs 363,116.70 (debt service interest, fees), consistent with detail. Re-check 2026-10-28 (attempt 2): statement 'Property' 4,544,376.24 split into Property Tax 4,539,184.59 (1110 4,149,537.90 p8 + Special Building 389,646.69 p16) and Penalties and Interest on Taxes 5,191.65 (1140 4,745.87 p8 + 445.78 p16); 'County receipts' 43,943.75 split into Fines and Licenses 26,722.65 (2110) and ESU Receipts 17,221.10 (2210) from the p8 County Sources breakdown. Exhibit N 2650 lines moved to Building and Grounds (the statement's Operation and maintenance of plant 918,169.80 = 2610 + 2630 + 2650 + 2660); program lines follow the statement's grouping: 3535 and 3551 (17,773.91 = State programs) -> State Categorical Programs, 6200/6406/6408/6992/6998 (375,435.92 = Federal programs) -> Federal Programs. Label 4998 corrected to 'ESSERS III' as printed.
